name: QY-ED
note: quark wye + electron delta, sharing 2 nodes (both spokes). Quark wye: hub m5, spokes m1/m3/m4. Electron delta: m2 (fresh) + m3, m4 (two quark-wye spokes). Sharing spokes (not the hub) keeps every dim-pair distinct -> R1-compliant. Replaces the earlier hub-sharing version, which violated R1. Neutrino sector open.
